article.headline: MLB playoff baseball returns after 335 days with Wild Card Series games
article.summary: After an 11-month gap, MLB's postseason begins Tuesday with four Wild Card Series games, including Phillies at Braves at 2 p.m. ET.
article.body:
Playoff baseball is back. The gap since the last postseason game stretched 335 days—exactly 11 months—making Tuesday's Wild Card Series games the long-awaited return to October baseball.

The postseason matters most to teams fighting for survival. The Phillies, despite a 5-10 stretch down the stretch that nearly cost them their playoff berth, reached the postseason for a fifth consecutive year. A 7-3 victory on the final day at Citizens Bank Park kept their season alive. The White Sox and Astros, meanwhile, finished with the 12th- and 14th-most wins in the Majors, yet both earned playoff spots in an unusual AL season where the three best teams clustered in the East while Central and West teams scrambled for spots. Houston became the first division winner to not finish above .500 since divisions began in 1969.

Tuesday features four games across both leagues. The Phillies face the Braves at 2 p.m. ET with Jesús Luzardo starting for Philadelphia and Chris Sale taking the mound for Atlanta. The White Sox play the Astros at 5 p.m. ET on Peacock and NBCSN. Both lineups feature established rosters, though neither team enters the series particularly hot—the White Sox and Astros both finished September under .500.

In roughly a month, the 2026 World Series champion will be crowned. But first comes the full gauntlet of playoff games, starting Tuesday.

article.summary: The New York Giants released wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr. on Tuesday after he played only 19 snaps across three games and failed to catch a pass.
article.body:
Beckham's return to the team where he began his career lasted just three weeks. The 33-year-old played 19 snaps over three games, saw a single target and didn't catch a pass, according to Next Gen Stats. Despite hopes he could recapture the form that earned him three consecutive Pro Bowls to start his career, no role materialized for him with the Giants.

The release signals that the team has moved on from sentiment toward focusing on players who can contribute immediately. With Malik Nabers, Malachi Fields and Darnell Mooney accounting for nearly all wide receiver targets through three games, Beckham's inability to see significant playing time made his presence expendable. Since he did not play special teams, keeping him around made little sense for New York.

Beckham faced a steep climb to even make the roster in the offseason, but he secured a spot on the initial 53-man roster at the end of August. However, his lack of usage underscored the reality that injuries to other receivers would have been required for him to make an impact. The question now is whether Beckham might find a new opportunity with another NFL club that could use wide receiver depth.

Chris Sale will take the mound for the Braves in Game 1 of the series, coming off one of the best regular seasons by an Atlanta pitcher with a 2.16 ERA, third in the Majors. Sale's ERA against the Phillies this season was even better at 2.08 across four starts.

This marks the third time in five years these NL East rivals have carried their playoff battle into October. The Braves won their division for the seventh time in nine seasons, but that regular-season success has not translated in recent postseason matchups. Philadelphia defeated Atlanta in the National League Division Series in both 2022 and 2023, despite the Braves holding home-field advantage each year.

During the regular season, the Braves dominated the head-to-head matchup, winning nine of thirteen games against the Phillies. Philadelphia arrives in Atlanta having narrowly secured the final wild-card spot, clinching with a 7-3 victory over Tampa Bay. The Phillies will send left-hander Luzardo to open for Philadelphia, working his way back from left shoulder inflammation after his last start on September 7.

Game 1 airs on NBC and Peacock, with additional games to follow if needed in the best-of-three format.

article.headline: Spain hosts Croatia in Nations League with 39-game winning streak on the line
article.summary: World champions Spain face Croatia on Tuesday in Seville in a UEFA Nations League Group A3 match, with Spain seeking to extend their record 39-game European winning streak.
article.body:
Spain's 39-game unbeaten run—a record for any European national team—faces its sternest test yet as world champions host Croatia in Seville on Tuesday evening. The streak has transformed La Roja into what observers describe as an imperious side, yet Croatia arrives fresh from a 2-1 victory over Czechia under new manager Slaven Bilić.

For Spanish fans, this match marks a homecoming celebration. Spain won the World Cup in New Jersey, and this is their first competitive home fixture since that triumph. The world champions already defeated England 3-2 in their opening Nations League game after coming from behind, while Croatia's midfield—led by the 41-year-old Luka Modric—will attempt to disrupt Spain's rhythm.

The generational clash features 19-year-old Barcelona winger Lamine Yamal against Modric, who has not slowed despite his age. Yamal scored within two minutes against England and has seven goals in La Liga this season. Modric scored Croatia's opener against Czechia and remains the architect of his team's play. Spain's attack also features Barcelona midfielder Dani Olmo, who provided an assist in their England win.

Spain will be without goalkeeper Joan García due to a knee injury and defender Pedro Porro, who was hurt in Tottenham's match against Aston Villa. De la Fuente must adjust Spain's right defensive flank. Despite Croatia's improvements under Bilić, most analysis suggests Spain's form makes them heavy favorites in what is expected to be a celebratory evening in Seville.

article.headline: Royal family questions Harry and Meghan's motives after U.K. return, palace issues clarification
article.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle have been back in the U.K. for a month, but senior royal family members still don't know their agenda, prompting King Charles to issue a letter clarifying the couple's status as non-working royals.
article.body:
A month into their U.K. return, the royal family remains uncertain about what Harry and Meghan are trying to accomplish. On September 16, a palace source told People magazine: "The royal family still don't know what their motives are," highlighting the tension surrounding the couple's relocation from California, where they had lived for six years.

The uncertainty matters because it signals a fundamental breakdown in communication between the palace and the couple. Royal experts are divided on whether the palace is justified in its stance or overstepping boundaries. Some say the intervention was necessary to reaffirm that Harry and Meghan remain private citizens and will not resume a "half-in, half-out" royal role, while others argue the palace is undermining their return.

King Charles responded with a letter through the Lord Chamberlain stating that Harry and Meghan would be classified as non-working royals. Royal broadcaster Ian Pelham Turner told Fox News Digital that this letter was unnecessary and created "humiliation for the couple." Turner said Harry and Meghan want privacy to protect their children and cover charity activities, but the palace is preventing them from creating royal-style events. British royal expert Hilary Fordwich countered that the letter was simply a clarification of the agreement Harry and Meghan made when they stepped away as senior royals in 2020.

The couple's team pushed back against wording in the palace letter describing them as "private citizens" rather than "public figures," according to Newsweek. A years-long rift with Prince William persists, with Harry saying he is not on speaking terms with his brother; their last time together was Queen Elizabeth II's funeral in September 2022.

article.headline: Tom Cruise transforms into oil baron in Alejandro González Iñárritu's 'weirdest' satirical comedy
article.summary: Tom Cruise plays Digger Rockwell, a bizarre Texan oil tycoon in director Alejandro González Iñárritu's divisive eco-satire that marks the biggest creative risk of Cruise's career.
article.body:
Tom Cruise appears unrecognizable in Digger, hidden beneath prosthetic makeup as Digger Rockwell, a balding, greying, paunchy oil baron—a stark departure from his typical athletic, ageless hero roles. The BBC describes it as the "weirdest film" Cruise has ever made, one where he risks being called pretentious and self-indulgent rather than breaking bones on set.

Directed by Alejandro González Iñárritu, the Mexican filmmaker behind Birdman and The Revenant, Digger functions as an eco-satire that explores self-delusion and the blurred line between art and artist. According to IndieWire, it represents the third chapter in Iñárritu's loose trilogy of postmodern films examining creativity when reality has become stranger than fiction. The film is conceptually challenging and deliberately bizarre, making it unlikely to appeal to mainstream audiences expecting another Mission: Impossible installment.

Rockwell's character lives in a historic mansion filled with stuffed exotic animals—a Victorian natural history museum aesthetic—yet worries obsessively about his scrawny pet cat. He is deeply concerned with money above all else, caring least about the environment. His half-sister, a green-energy entrepreneur played by Sandra Hüller, appears underused in the narrative. The BBC notes that nothing in Digger is subtle; most viewers won't attend, and some who do may leave halfway through. Yet this divisiveness doesn't signal failure—it signals a film content to be exactly what it is: hectoring, challenging, and entirely uninterested in conventional entertainment.

article.headline: Six Flags closes X2 roller coaster permanently after years of reported injuries
article.summary: Six Flags Magic Mountain permanently closed the X2 roller coaster on Tuesday following a history of injuries and deaths, including lawsuits from riders who suffered brain injuries.
article.body:
Six Flags Magic Mountain's X2, the world's first roller coaster with seats that spin 360 degrees, is now permanently closed. The ride was first shut down temporarily in July after back-to-back brain injury reports, then closed for good this week.

The closure matters because X2 had been the park's flagship attraction since opening as X in 2002, drawing more than 16 million riders over its lifetime. Park president Brian Oerding said in a statement: "While X2 consistently passed a multitude of safety tests, we have decided to close the ride because we believe it's the right thing to do. Ride safety is a cornerstone of our business, and when we see guest confidence affected, we take it seriously."

The ride's history includes multiple injury lawsuits. Christopher Hawley, 22, died in 2022 after riding X2 and losing consciousness shortly after exiting; his family settled a lawsuit in August. Hilda Farias died from a brain bleed after riding in 2010. Two other riders, Sheila Katerelos and Lucy Alvarez, filed separate suits claiming traumatic brain injuries in 2020 and 2021. The ride had also required repairs since its 2002 opening—it was closed months after debut to fix design flaws, then again in 2007 to replace trains with lighter ones before reopening as X2 in 2008.

article.headline: Senegal chases first win under Vieira against Ethiopia in AFCON qualifier
article.summary: Senegal faces Ethiopia on Tuesday in Bahir Dar in the second matchday of the 2027 AFCON qualifiers, seeking Patrick Vieira's first victory after drawing 1-1 with Mozambique.
article.body:
Senegal dominated their opening match against Mozambique but could not convert chances in a 1-1 draw, Nicolas Jackson's early goal cancelled by Geny Catamo's first-half equalizer. Now the Lions of Teranga travel to Bahir Dar International Stadium to face Ethiopia, who fell 1-0 to Sudan in the qualifying opener when Mohamed Eisa scored in the 86th minute.

Viera has made intensity and clinical finishing his priorities. "We'll continue to play with more intensity and capitalise on the chances we've created," he told reporters. "It's important for us to play a good match, a complete match." Despite the long journey to Ethiopia, Vieira said the team will be "competitive in terms of tactics, physical condition, and mental strength." Senegal will be without Sadio Mané due to a physical issue but retain Nicolas Jackson, Kalidou Koulibaly, Idrissa Gana Gueye, and Pape Matar Sarr. Saudi Pro League defender Malang Sarr is set for his Senegal debut.

Ethiopia coach Yohannes Sahilu stressed focus after his strikers missed chances against Sudan. "We should be focused on the game. We should avoid any costly mistakes. We should finish off the chances we create," he said. Bahir Dar, which has hosted the Waliyas only once in five years, is considered a fortress where Ethiopia beat Ivory Coast in 2021 AFCON qualifying.

After matchday one, Sudan leads Group J with three points. Senegal and Mozambique have one point each, while Ethiopia has none. The top two teams will qualify directly for the tournament in Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda.

article.headline: Ghana faces Gambia in Africa Cup of Nations qualifier with fans urged to show belief
article.summary: Ghana's Sports Fund Administrator calls on supporters to trust the Black Stars ahead of their Africa Cup of Nations qualification match against Gambia today.
article.body:
Dr. David Kofi Wuaku, Administrator of the Ghana Sports Fund, has urged Ghanaians to give the Black Stars their full support ahead of today's match against Gambia, saying players perform best when they feel the nation is behind them.

Wuaku acknowledged that Ghanaian football fans are passionate about lineups and tactics in the days before matches, but emphasized a shift in responsibility once play begins. "Every Ghanaian is a coach in the days before a big match," he said. "But once the whistle blows, our job changes. Our job is to believe."

The administrator pointed to how players respond to crowd energy, noting that young players feel every pass and missed chance deeply. "A player who hears his name chanted after a mistake plays the next ball without fear. A player who hears silence or insults hesitates," Wuaku explained, underscoring how national support shapes performance. He emphasized that football careers are shaped by moments of confidence and doubt, with a supportive nation able to tip the balance.

Wuaku also called for maturity in how fans respond after the final whistle, whatever the result. "If we win, let us celebrate with humility. If we do not, let us respond with respect and encouragement," he said. He stressed that lasting success requires a nation standing with its team across every season, not only on match day.

article.summary: Inglaterra viaja a Praga el martes 29 de septiembre para enfrentar a República Checa en la segunda fecha de la Nations League, obligada a ganar tras perder 3-2 ante España en su debut.
article.body:
Inglaterra llegaba ganando 2-1 en Wembley con goles de Anthony Gordon y Harry Kane, pero España completó la remontada en los minutos finales, aprovechando incluso un penal fallado por el capitán inglés. Esa derrota deja a los Tres Leones en una situación crítica: no pueden permitirse otro tropiezo si quieren mantener sus aspiraciones en un Grupo A3 que también integra a España y Croacia.

Para Tuchel, el resultado contra España llegó en un momento complicado: el técnico alemán debe lidiar con una crisis de lesiones que lo ha privado de Mainoo, Rashford, Rice y Palmer, entre otros. Tampoco convocó a Foden, Watkins e Toney. Sin embargo, recuperó a Trent Alexander-Arnold tras más de un año ausente de la selección.

República Checa tampoco puede darse lujos. Los checos cayeron 2-1 como locales ante Croacia en el debut bajo las órdenes de Santi Denia, con goles de Luka Modrić y Mario Pašalić. El equipo mostró carácter para acercarse al empate sobre el cierre, pero la derrota lo dejó en la obligación de reaccionar de inmediato en casa.

England llega como favorito por su jerarquía de plantel, pero los checos contarán con el respaldo de su afición en el Fortuna Arena. Históricamente, los Tres Leones dominan el enfrentamiento con tres victorias en cinco encuentros oficiales, siendo el más reciente un triunfo 1-0 en la Eurocopa 2021.

article.headline: Liberty stuns top-seeded Lynx 91-75 in first WNBA playoff game
article.summary: The New York Liberty defeated the No. 1 seed Minnesota Lynx 91-75 on Sunday in Game 1 of their first-round series, with forward Breanna Stewart scoring 34 points.
article.body:
Breanna Stewart poured in 34 points, 12 rebounds, and six assists as the New York Liberty claimed a stunning 91-75 road victory over the top-seeded Minnesota Lynx on Sunday in the opening game of their first-round playoff series. The 16-point margin marked the Liberty's largest road playoff win since 2015.

The result matters because it gives the Liberty momentum heading into Game 2 on Tuesday at home at the Barclays Center, where they can close out the series. The Lynx entered as the No. 1 seed with homecourt advantage, making the upset significant in a best-of-three first round where every game is pivotal.

Leonie Fiebich added 16 points and Sabrina Ionescu contributed 13 as three Liberty players reached double figures. After the win, Stewart said: "We were ready to go. I think our entire group, we knew what it was going to take and everything that we've been through prepared us for this moment." She noted that the noise at Target Center was challenging but the team maintained composure.

Elsewhere on Sunday, the No. 3 seed Las Vegas Aces defeated the No. 6 Indiana Fever 102-85. Reigning MVP A'ja Wilson led the Aces with 38 points and 16 rebounds, becoming the first player in WNBA history to record at least 30 points and 15 rebounds in multiple playoff games. The first round continues Tuesday and Wednesday with Game 2s.

article.headline: Morocco faces Lesotho in AFCON qualifier at South African stadium
article.summary: Morocco plays Lesotho on Tuesday at Free State Toyota Stadium in Bloemfontein, South Africa, in their second Africa Cup of Nations 2027 qualifying match, with captain Achraf Hakimi returning after suspension.
article.body:
Issa Diop welcomed the challenge ahead of Morocco's clash with Lesotho in South Africa, calling it his first away match in Africa. "It's my first time in South Africa. It will also be my first away match in Africa. It's something new for me, and I'm really looking forward to taking on this challenge," the defender said at the pre-match press conference.

Morocco, ranked Africa's number one, arrives in Bloemfontein after opening their qualifying campaign with a 2-0 victory over Gabon in Rabat. The Atlas Lions seek another positive result to build momentum in the AFCON 2027 qualifying rounds. Defender Nayef Aguerd remained in Morocco following recent surgery, with the coaching staff managing his gradual return to fitness rather than rushing him into competitive action.

The fixture takes place at the Free State Toyota Stadium because Lesotho does not have a CAF-approved stadium. Morocco's squad includes World Cup quarter-finalists such as Real Madrid's Brahim Diaz, Paris Saint-Germain's Achraf Hakimi, Bayern Munich's Ismael Saibari, and new Manchester City signing Ayyoub Bouaddi. Hakimi and Saibari return after missing the opening match due to suspension.

Diop stressed that discipline and focus will prove crucial as Morocco look to secure victory in an away fixture. "We know that away games in Africa are tough. I hope that tomorrow we'll put in a top-class performance and win the match," he said.

article.headline: Judge ruled out for Wild Card Series against Red Sox with calf strain
article.summary: Yankees slugger Aaron Judge will miss the entire Wild Card Series against Boston after being sidelined since September 16 with a calf injury, though designated hitter Giancarlo Stanton is available.
article.body:
Aaron Judge, the back-to-back American League MVP, will not play in the Yankees' Wild Card Series against the Red Sox despite showing signs of improvement in recent days. The 34-year-old has been on the injured list since September 16 with a calf strain and will miss at least the first round of the playoffs entirely.

Judge's absence significantly weakens the Yankees' lineup heading into the postseason. The team ranked 11th in MLB in OPS during the regular season and 9th in runs scored, numbers that improved considerably when Judge was healthy. The Yankees were 41-25 when Judge started and 52-43 without him. Beyond Ben Rice, the Yankees lack depth in the batting order to compensate for losing their slugger.

On Monday, Yankees manager Aaron Boone told reporters that Judge had been "making progress" after taking batting practice on Sunday, and Judge himself said he felt great running on an anti-gravity treadmill. Despite these optimistic signals and plans to potentially run outside, the team decided to leave him off the roster. One positive development for the Yankees: designated hitter Giancarlo Stanton will be available after missing time with his own calf strain. Stanton has been the active career home run leader with 456 across 17 seasons and has hit .254 with 18 home runs in 48 career playoff games.

The Wild Card Series begins Tuesday night with Game 1 in the Bronx, a best-of-three matchup where the Yankees will start Cam Schlittler against Red Sox starter Payton Tolle.

article.headline: FBI seizes $15 billion in Operation Blackout targeting global scam compounds
article.summary: FBI Director Kash Patel announced that Operation Blackout has seized more than $15 billion in assets and cryptocurrency while dismantling international fraud networks that targeted senior citizens across multiple countries.
article.body:
The FBI's Operation Blackout has shut down over 500 fake investment websites and freed thousands of trafficked workers forced to operate fraud schemes from fortified compounds in Southeast Asia and the Middle East. Most of the $15 billion seizure came from Operation Zephyr Exodus, the investigation into Cambodia-based Prince Holding Group, which in October 2025 resulted in the civil forfeiture of approximately 127,271 Bitcoin then valued at about $15 billion.

Senior citizens bore the brunt of these schemes, which operated through social media, phone calls, text messages and Telegram. Victims were cultivated into online relationships before being steered toward fraudulent cryptocurrency investment platforms, where they believed their money was generating returns but could not withdraw it. FBI Director Kash Patel described the criminal operations as "towns, these are cities" and "actual villages with structures where they force people into forced labor."

The operation involved coordinated international action, with authorities arresting hundreds of suspects and warning more than 10,000 Americans before they could fall victim to the scams. The FBI prevented estimated losses of more than $500 million through these warnings. An August operation at Cambodia's roughly 200-acre O'Smach Resort compound involved searches of 28 buildings and seized 113 hard drives, 15 computers and 35 boxes of evidence.

The investigation has strengthened international cooperation, with more than 20 countries now coordinating efforts against these criminal networks. The FBI said the investigation would continue until those responsible face justice and measures are strengthened to protect Americans from fraud.

article.headline: Social Security COLA for 2027 forecast at 3.5%, largest increase in four years
article.summary: The Social Security Administration will announce the 2027 cost-of-living adjustment on October 14, with forecasts predicting a 3.5% increase—the largest in four years—that would raise average monthly benefits by about $67.90.
article.body:
The Senior Citizen League predicts a 3.5% cost-of-living adjustment for 2027, up from 2.8% in 2026 and 2.5% in 2025. For the average Social Security recipient currently receiving $1,940 monthly, this would mean an increase of $67.90, bringing the average benefit to $2,007.

But the larger raise comes with a significant caveat: inflation is driving the increase, and that same inflation erodes much of the gain for seniors. According to TSCL Executive Director Shannon Benton, "The reality is that older Americans allocate their budgets differently than people still in the workforce, so inflation hits them differently." Social Security benefits have lost 13.7% of their buying power over the past 10 years, according to the Senior Citizens League, because the COLA formula is based on the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, which measures how workers spend, not retirees.

Additionally, seniors enrolled in Medicare Part B will see some of their COLA gains offset by premium increases. In 2026, the standard monthly Part B premium rose by $17.90. The exact 2027 Part B increase is not yet known, but any rise will reduce the net benefit of the COLA.

The Social Security Administration will announce the official 2027 COLA on October 14, following the Bureau of Labor Statistics release of September's Consumer Price Index. If the 3.5% prediction holds, it would rank 19th among COLA increases since 1977, when Social Security began calculating the annual adjustment.

His viral success has led to roles he credits to social media, including a starring role alongside Owen Wilson in the upcoming "Rolling Loud: The Movie," scheduled for release on October 2. article.headline: Camryn Manheim jokes she wanted gay son at Human Rights Campaign gala
article.summary: Actress Camryn Manheim said at the Human Rights Campaign's National Dinner on Sunday that she "always wanted a gay son," but her son turned out to be heterosexual.
article.body:
At the Human Rights Campaign's National Dinner on Sunday, Camryn Manheim joked from the stage that despite her best efforts, her son is heterosexual. "I have photographs of my son in high heels, in full drag, he knows every word to every musical ever written," Manheim said, adding that she thought "I had this f---ing thing locked up, but no, no, he's the only straight guy in his entire musical theater company."

Manheim, best known for her role as Ellenor Frutt in the late 1990s and early 2000s drama series "The Practice," presented her friend and fellow actress Marcia Gay Harden with the Ally for Equality Award. She contrasted her experience with Harden's, saying that when Harden called her a decade ago to say her son was gay, Manheim replied: "All I said was, 'Oh my God, you are so f---ing lucky!'"

Manheim elaborated on what she felt she missed by not having a gay son, saying: "I love that relationship between gay sons and their mothers. I wanted to be the picket sign-holding mom who would beat the s--- out of somebody for her kid. I mean, let's just admit it, gay sons are the best, right?" She noted that her son's fairy godfather, Aaron Walton, was present at the event.

Milo Manheim, Camryn's only child and 25 years old, is an actor best known for his starring role as Zed in the Disney Channel film franchise "Zombies." He appeared in the 2023 Christmas musical "Journey to Bethlehem" and placed second on season 27 of "Dancing with the Stars" in 2018.

article.headline: Henry Winkler's 'Chanukah Song' shoutout from Adam Sandler led to Waterboy role
article.summary: Actor Henry Winkler said a 1994 Saturday Night Live shoutout from Adam Sandler mentioning his Happy Days character led to him calling Sandler, which eventually resulted in Winkler being cast as Coach Klein in the 1998 comedy film The Waterboy without an audition.
article.body:
When Adam Sandler performed "The Chanukah Song" on Saturday Night Live in 1994, he included a line about Winkler's iconic character: "Guess who eats together at the Carnegie Deli? Bowzer from Sha Na Na and Arthur Fonzarelli." That shoutout prompted Winkler to call Sandler directly to thank him.

The unexpected connection changed Winkler's career path. Years later, when Sandler was casting The Waterboy, he offered Winkler the role of Coach Klein without requiring him to audition. "All of a sudden, I got picked to be the coach. And I didn't have to audition," Winkler told Forbes. "So the man is brilliant."

In The Waterboy, Winkler's college football coach character recruits Sandler's waterboy to play on his struggling team. The 1998 comedy became one of Sandler's most popular films. Winkler noted that college football players have told him they watch the film on team buses heading to games.

During production, Sandler called Winkler at 11:30 p.m. asking for an emergency favor: an actor hadn't shown up. Winkler drove to the park in Los Angeles, received makeup until 3:30 a.m., and filmed the scene. For his unscheduled night work, Winkler said he received a cookie and didn't even get to keep his wardrobe.

Adam Scott has made every Presidents Cup team since 2003, when the Internationals and Americans tied. Since then, the Internationals have lost every one—a streak that extended this past week as Team USA dominated Sunday singles to secure victory.

While he has won 14 times on the PGA Tour and claimed the Masters, he continues searching for the achievements that would make him feel his golf journey is complete. The Presidents Cup title has become central to that quest, with Scott describing his desire to finally win it as desperate.

article.summary: Original Harry Potter film actor Warwick Davis will reprise his role as Professor Flitwick in HBO's new Harry Potter television adaptation, calling it "a huge honour" ahead of the series premiere.
article.body:
Warwick Davis, who portrayed Professor Flitwick across the Harry Potter film franchise, is returning to the character for HBO's upcoming television adaptation. The actor called the opportunity "a huge honour" and said he remains "excited to retell these stories because they're fantastic stories."

Davis has been connected to the Harry Potter world for decades. He worked on the films for over 11 years and has continued collaborating with the team at the studio tour in Watford. "Harry Potter has become part of my professional life since the late 90s throughout until now," he told the Press Association. "So it's a constant. It's fabulous."

The actor described Flitwick as one of his favourite characters to play in his career. "He's a very warm, kind of likeable character," Davis said, explaining that he based the professor on some of his own teachers—the kind who would be understanding if a student forgot their homework. Davis remained tight-lipped about details of the new series, noting "it's all very top secret."

Davis joins a cast that includes Paapa Essiedu as Severus Snape, Janet McTeer as Minerva McGonagall, Nick Frost as Rubeus Hagrid, and John Lithgow as Albus Dumbledore. The series will premiere on December 25, 2026, on HBO Max.

For Madagascar, however, the situation is urgent. Only the highest-ranked non-host nation in Group L will earn the group's additional qualifying spot, meaning Nigeria, Guinea-Bissau, and Madagascar must compete for one berth. After Matchday 1, Guinea-Bissau and Nigeria both held three points, widening the gap.

A second consecutive defeat would significantly damage Madagascar's qualification prospects in a six-match campaign.
